description: core baseline guards, registered BY THE PLUGIN so they update with it (forked from core-claude 0.9.8). PreToolUse: judge-hook on every tool call (the deny/allow/gated/escalate rules engine; its complete ruleset ships in judge-rules.json beside it, ~/.claude/judge-rules.json is an overlay) and jev-intent-gate on Bash/Edit/Write plus their skyline equivalents (the two dependency-pin rules core-claude judges with a `claude -p` subprocess, decided here by ONE Jev request after a regex pre-match; they are removed from this plugin's judge-rules.json so nothing fires twice). PostToolUse: writing-guard on write/edit tools plus their skyline equivalents. Stop: jev-research-nudge (a regex hedge gate, then ONE Jev request; silent in agent-org sessions) in place of core-claude's `claude -p` research-nudge. Every Jev call fails open: no TYPESAFE_API_KEY, a timeout, or an unparseable reply allows and logs one stderr line. Do not install core-claude beside this plugin.
